scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: node -e "if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' && !process.env.SKIP_TESTS) { process.exit(require('child_process').spawnSync('npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client', { shell: true, stdio: 'inherit' }).status); } else { console.log('Tests ignorés (environnement de production/déploiement).'); }"
